text:
maria: quick heads-up — ran a smoke of awq-int8 on llama2-13b-sf with cachepack prefetched prefixes + continuous-batch. seeing ~1.3 pts QA-F1 drop on our conv eval when cache-hit > 0.6. anyone seen prefix eviction cause off-by-one KV mismatch? :thinking:
aj: can you paste the config and the exact metric? is this stable across runs?
maria: metric=QA-F1 (conv eval), baseline fp8=86.2, awq-int8+continuous-batch=84.9. runx shows variance +/-0.3, but shift persists. config:
```
model: llama2-13b-sf-awq-int8
batcher:
  mode: continuous
  max_delay_ms: 8
cache:
  prefix_policy: cachepack
  ttl_ms: 30000
  eviction: prefix-lru
```
kevin: interesting — cachepack's prefix-lru may evict earlier keys for different quant variants. possible stale KV shapes? did you enable kv-versioning?
maria: no kv-versioning. thought cachepack would be compatible across q-variants since kernel uses same kv layout.
eva: AWQ has known rounding nondets with different batch sizes — try disabling continuous batching to see if batching interaction is amplifying quant noise.
aj: +1. also try forcing seq_len=128 for warmup and check kv hit ratio. can you share a sample trace?
maria: attaching inline trace snippet (sanitized):
```
[INFO] kv_cache.hit=0.67 seq=112 batch_sz=6 quant=awq-int8
[WARN] prefix_evicted key=usr-ctx-983 ttl_expired=false evicted_by=space_pressure
[DEBUG] out_token=42 logprob=-0.2
```
sam: if eviction_by=space_pressure is the culprit, lowering batcher.max_delay or increasing cache.ttl should reduce evictions but may raise cost. Worth trying two runs.
aj: also flagging that some kernels reorder matmul ops for int8 on aarch64 which leads to tiny fp shifts; combined with prefix caching these can accumulate.
maria: running two shadow runs now: (A) continuous on + ttl=30s; (B) continuous off + ttl=60s. will post numbers in ~15m
infra-bot: started job jobs/17822 (shadow-run) on dedicated-gpu-pool-2, ETA ~14m
kevin: if B fixes it, we'll need a graceful fallback: when cache hit ratio>threshold and model variant is quantized, route to non-continuous batcher or different kernel set.
eva: opened GH issue rwd/infra#4821 with hypothesis and checklist — please add logs
maria: thanks — will add logs. preliminary numbers from run A: QA-F1=85.0 (still down). run B in progress.
aj: small note — for reproducibility also set RNG seed in AWQ pipeline and disable async prefetch in the runtime.
maria: done: seed=42, prefetch=false. run B finished: QA-F1=86.1 (within baseline). Looks like the combination of continuous batching + cachepack eviction + awq int8 non-determinism causes the regression.
kevin: great find. next steps: 1) add kv-versioning toggle; 2) heuristic: if model.quantized and batcher.mode==continuous and cache.hit>0.5 then prefer deterministic kernel set; 3) add e2e test.
sam: I'll prototype the routing rule. tagging @product for potential perf/cost tradeoff
maria: filing a short postmortem and an eval to track this across other quant variants. thanks everyone :rocket:
